## MSL AI Systems — Starter Speed-to-Lead Router
**Diagnostic Platform:** https://auditiq-ai.vercel.app
**Portfolio:** https://msl-portfolio.vercel.app
**Autonomy Level:** L2 (85% Deterministic Plumbing + 1 Isolated AI Classifier)

### How to Demo Out of the Box:
1. Click the orange **Execute workflow** button at the bottom.
2. Node `00` injects a sample B2B lead, normalizes the phone to `E.164`, scores priority, and outputs a 1-Click WhatsApp deep link.
3. Every node runs 100% green out of the box with zero `$env` errors (Node `01` Webhook is disabled by default so the orange button always fires `00` immediately).
